svg.title: Tasks / Who May Write Task Files
svg.desc: The persistence authority is the only code that writes tasks.jsonl and archive.jsonl; the durable on-disk state around it is either the source of truth or recoverable.. Solid colored outlines mark exact authored boundary members; dotted outlines mark collapsed elements that contain members. Neither is an inferred trust envelope.

text.tspan: Tasks / Who May Write Task Files
